messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — eval-runner is reassigning leases in a tight loop and flooding the dispatcher queues. Started ~10m ago.
anya: Logs show repeated renew failures + immediate reschedule, looks like a TTL/heartbeat mismatch.
anya: Log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T08:01:23Z eval-runner[pid=1234] INFO lease renew failed shard=42 err=stale-leader
2026-03-20T08:01:23Z eval-runner[pid=1234] INFO reassigning shard=42 -> worker=wk-7
2026-03-20T08:01:23Z eval-runner[pid=1234] INFO lease acquired shard=42
2026-03-20T08:01:24Z eval-runner[pid=1234] INFO lease renew failed shard=42 err=stale-leader
```
raj: :eyes: saw a huge spike in eval_shard_reassigns and queue backlog in the last 5m. Grafana dashboard  /d/ops/eval-runner shows it.
mike: Any recent deploys to the scheduler or worker lease code? Could be a rollout that changed TTL semantics.
sophia: There was a small change in the lease manager landed earlier today (PR 5123) that touched renew jitter. Might be related.
anya: Repro attempt: run 200 shards across 20 workers and bump network noise. Config used:
```
lease_ttl: 5s
heartbeat_interval: 1s
renew_jitter: 0.0  # previously 0.2
max_reassigns_per_sec: 0  # disabled
```
anya: With renew_jitter=0.0 we get synchronized renews -> thundering renew failures and immediate reassigns.
raj: Ah — removing jitter + disabled throttling is a pretty direct path to stampede.
mike: Short-term mitigation: re-enable renew_jitter and add a small debounce window before reassigning a just-lost lease (e.g., wait 2s). Also set max_reassigns_per_sec=50.
sophia: I'll prepare a canary: add jitter=0.15, debounce=2s, max_reassigns_per_sec=100 on 10% of nodes.
anya: Also adding a dispatcher-side guard to ignore reassign requests for the same shard if last_assigned_ts < now - 500ms to avoid immediate double flips.
raj: Can we also add a Prometheus alert: rate(eval_shard_reassigns[1m]) > 100 -> page oncall infra? current rate is ~800/min.
infra-bot: Alert rule created: eval.reassign.rate.high -> notify @oncall if > 100/min for 2m.
ci-bot: CI: started pipeline for PR #5238 (scheduler: add jitter/debounce) — running integration tests.
mike: We should also add a CI test that simulates synchronized lease renewals so this regression doesn't slip.
anya: Filed integration test ticket: INFRA-1178, will add pod-kill / synthetic-network-delay scenario to eval-integ.
sophia: PR 5238 opened: https://git.internal/reds/5238 — includes jitter default 0.15 and dispatcher rate_limit.
raj: Quick rollback plan if canary fails: pin scheduler to previous image tag by scaling selector and draining new pods.
anya: Canary rolled out to 10% at 08:35. Reassign rate dropped from ~800/min to ~3/min within 90s.
mike: Nice. Can we follow up with a postmortem and add a test that asserts renew_jitter > 0 in default config?
anya: Agreed. I'll write a short postmortem and include suggested safe defaults.
sophia: I'll coordinate the rollout to 100% after 30m monitoring window and merge the CI test.
ci-bot: Deploy to 10% completed, health checks passed.
anya: Closing loop: mitigation worked, metrics are stable. Moving to full rollout in 30m. Thanks all.
raj: Thanks — great catch. :thumbsup:
